caption: The drawing depicts a chalice-like trophy cup with two symmetrical handles extending horizontally from each side. The main body of the cup is rendered in shades of grey, suggesting a metallic or silver material, with a rounded basin and a wide, circular foot for stability. Around the upper part of the cup is a band colored in light pink with marbled, irregular white veining, bordered by thin grey lines at the top and bottom. At the front and center of this pink band is a grey medallion featuring a profile of a woman's head, adorned with a helmet or headpiece. The cup has a red, ribbed lid that sits flush with the top edge. The drawing appears carefully shaded to depict a three-dimensional appearance and includes a light penciled box outlining the composition. The words “Actual Size” are inscribed in small script near the pedestal base, and the name "Samuel Klein" is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Spoon Holder
